title.value: Hadamard product in deep learning: Introduction, Advances and Challenges

title.quote: Hadamard product in deep learning: Introduction, Advances and Challenges

analysis.description: This paper surveys the role of the Hadamard product in deep learning, examining it as a core architectural primitive. It provides a comprehensive taxonomy of its applications across four principal domains: higher-order correlation, multimodal data fusion, dynamic representation modulation, and efficient pairwise operations. It emphasizes the geometrical and computational advantages of the Hadamard product, particularly in multimodal fusion tasks and dynamic filtering/modulation of features.

type.justification: The paper includes numerical efficiency comparisons, practical implementations, and discusses empirical applications of the Hadamard product in deep learning.
type.quote: We demonstrate its natural applicability in multimodal fusion tasks, such as visual question answering, and its effectiveness in representation masking for applications including image inpainting and pruning.
